baitu-ji.genreZh: 越剧 / 南戏传统 · 白兔记
baitu-ji.registerZh: 流离求生与认亲：叙事跨度大，悲喜并陈。
baitu-ji.registerEn: Exile, survival, recognition: wide narrative span, grief beside reunion.
baitu-ji.rolesZh: 刘知远一线 · 李三娘一线
baitu-ji.rolesEn: Liu Zhiyuan line · Li Sanniang line
baitu-ji.listenZh: 先定场景（寒夜 / 奔波 / 团聚），再对唱词；未见全剧时 CER 会偏高属预期。
baitu-ji.listenEn: Anchor scene (cold night / road / reunion) first; higher CER on unseen stretches is expected.

biyu-zan-xinfang.genreZh: 越剧 · 碧玉簪 · 新房
biyu-zan-xinfang.registerZh: 闺房冷清：旦角抒情，怨与忍交织，文白夹杂。
biyu-zan-xinfang.registerEn: Cold bridal chamber: dan lyricism; resentment and endurance; literary–vernacular mix.
biyu-zan-xinfang.listenZh: 听冷清、怨悔套语；字不稳时用档案句锚定场景。
biyu-zan-xinfang.listenEn: Listen for cold-chamber and regret formulas; archive-anchor when ASR slips.

bubuxinjing-1.registerEn: Court intrigue and longing: witty speech beside lyric song; ranked address terms.
bubuxinjing-1.listenZh: 听名分称呼与风险暗示；字级不稳时靠场景卡。
bubuxinjing-1.listenEn: Track ranked address and risk hints; lean on scene cards when ASR wobbles.

chai-tou-feng.genreZh: 越剧 · 钗头凤（陆游·唐琬）
chai-tou-feng.genreEn: Yueju · Chai Tou Feng (Lu You · Tang Wan)
chai-tou-feng.registerZh: 旧情重逢：酸楚、错负，唱词典雅。
chai-tou-feng.registerEn: Old love meets again: bitterness and regret; literary diction.
chai-tou-feng.listenZh: 抓诀别与悔恨套语；短选段适合听「错、莫、难」等语气词。
chai-tou-feng.listenEn: Listen for parting/regret formulas and modal particles of denial and hardship.

chen-sanliang.genreZh: 越剧 · 公案 / 辩诬
chen-sanliang.registerZh: 据理力争：念白与唱夹杂，语气刚烈。
chen-sanliang.registerEn: Argument and defense: speech and song mixed; fierce tone.
chen-sanliang.listenZh: 听辩诬关键词与情绪冲高，不必句句对齐。
chen-sanliang.listenEn: Track defense keywords and rising affect more than every line.

he-wenxiu-suanming.genreZh: 越剧 · 何文秀 · 算命
he-wenxiu-suanming.registerZh: 算命对唱：念白问答与唱夹杂，机锋多。
he-wenxiu-suanming.registerEn: Fortune-telling duet: Q&A speech mixed with song; quick repartee.
he-wenxiu-suanming.listenZh: 先跟问答节奏，再抠字；算命术语易误识。
he-wenxiu-suanming.listenEn: Follow Q&A rhythm first; fortune-telling jargon often fools ASR.

hongloumeng-1.genreEn: Yueju · Dream of the Red Chamber excerpt
hongloumeng-1.registerZh: 宝黛情与贾府人事：雅俗并用。
hongloumeng-1.registerEn: Bao–Dai feeling and Jia-house affairs; literary beside vernacular.
hongloumeng-1.rolesEn: Jia Baoyu · Lin Daiyu and others
hongloumeng-1.listenZh: 先定人物关系，再听唱词；分段档案便于对照。
hongloumeng-1.listenEn: Fix character relations first, then lyrics; segmented archive helps.

hongloumeng-2.listenEn: Fix this part’s character relations first; compare with part 1 if needed.

hongloumeng-tianxia.genreZh: 越剧 · 天上掉下个林妹妹
hongloumeng-tianxia.registerZh: 初见倾心：短选段，人物称呼清晰。
hongloumeng-tianxia.registerEn: First meeting; short clip with clear address terms.
hongloumeng-tianxia.listenZh: 听初见称呼与惊喜语气。
hongloumeng-tianxia.listenEn: Listen for first-meeting address and surprise contour.

jingchai-ji.genreZh: 越剧 / 南戏传统 · 荆钗记
jingchai-ji.registerZh: 江边送别与嘱托：情义、赴考、荆钗信物并置。
jingchai-ji.registerEn: River farewell and counsel: devotion, exam journey, thorn-pin token.
jingchai-ji.rolesZh: 王十朋（生）· 钱玉莲（旦）
jingchai-ji.listenZh: 听「荆钗」信物与送别嘱托套语；对齐档案句比硬听字更有效。
jingchai-ji.listenEn: Listen for the hairpin token and parting counsel formulas; archive align beats raw ASR.

liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.genreZh: 越剧 · 生旦对唱（十八相送）
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.registerZh: 唱词为主，文白夹杂；托物、借景暗示情意，少直说。
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.registerEn: Mostly sung; literary–vernacular mix; affection coded through scenery and objects.
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.rolesZh: 梁山伯（小生）· 祝英台（闺门旦 / 花旦）
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.rolesEn: Liang Shanbo (xiaosheng) · Zhu Yingtai (guimen dan / huadan)
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.listenZh: 听称呼（梁兄、贤弟）与沿途托喻；字听不清也可跟「相送—暗恋—惜别」线。
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.listenEn: Track address terms and coded metaphors; follow farewell → coded love → parting even if ASR is rough.

liangzhu-shibaxiangsong-full.genreZh: 越剧 · 生旦对唱（十八相送全本）
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong-full.registerZh: 唱词为主，文白夹杂；长段相送，暗语更密。
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong-full.registerEn: Sung farewell walk; denser coded metaphors across a longer stretch.
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong-full.rolesZh: 梁山伯（小生）· 祝英台（闺门旦）
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong-full.listenZh: 分段听「起程—托景—将近终点」；注意英台旁敲侧击、山伯未悟。
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong-full.listenEn: Follow start → scenery codes → near parting; Zhu hints, Liang often misses the cue.

liangzhu-xia.registerZh: 悲剧收束，唱腔更沉；化蝶前的诀别语气。
liangzhu-xia.registerEn: Tragic close; heavier delivery before metamorphosis.
liangzhu-xia.listenZh: 听情绪下沉与诀别句群，不必强求每个字。
liangzhu-xia.listenEn: Listen for falling affect and farewell clusters, not every syllable.

limaohuan-taizi.genreZh: 戏曲传统 · 狸猫换太子
limaohuan-taizi.registerZh: 宫廷冤案：辨认、寻亲、公案语气，篇幅长。
limaohuan-taizi.registerEn: Court injustice: recognition, search, case tone; long form.
limaohuan-taizi.listenZh: 先定「阴谋—失散—辨认」大段，再听字。
limaohuan-taizi.listenEn: Anchor intrigue → separation → recognition before chasing characters.

longmen-kezhai.genreZh: 越剧改编 · 新龙门客栈
longmen-kezhai.registerZh: 武侠客栈：忠奸对照，念白与唱并进，口语感更强。
longmen-kezhai.registerEn: Wuxia inn: loyalty vs intrigue; speech and song; more colloquial.
longmen-kezhai.listenZh: 抓忠奸称呼与冲突句；长篇更适合跟读档案。
longmen-kezhai.listenEn: Track loyalty/villain address and conflict lines; long form favors archive follow-along.

mudanting-huanhunji.genreZh: 昆曲 / 戏曲传统 · 牡丹亭·还魂
mudanting-huanhunji.genreEn: Kunqu / theatre tradition · Peony Pavilion · Return
mudanting-huanhunji.registerZh: 情思与生死：辞彩华美，梦境、花园、还魂交织。
mudanting-huanhunji.registerEn: Love across life and death; ornate diction; dream, garden, return intertwined.
mudanting-huanhunji.listenZh: 先跟「梦—伤—还魂」大意，再抠字；华辞易导致字级识别不稳。
mudanting-huanhunji.listenEn: Follow dream → mourning → return first; ornate lines often destabilize character ASR.

para-2.registerZh: 折子选段：便于听说与档案对读，语体随出目变化。
para-2.registerEn: Excerpt pack for Speak ↔ archive check; register varies by scene.
para-2.listenZh: 用档案命中句回填情节，勿把折子当全剧。
para-2.listenEn: Use archive hits to recover plot; treat as excerpts, not full plays.

para-3.genreZh: 经典折子对照材料（含重叠段）
para-3.registerZh: 折子选段，部分与其他包重叠；适合检索对齐测试。
para-3.registerEn: Excerpt pack with overlap; good for alignment tests.
para-3.listenZh: 命中后看邻近句与场景卡，避免把重叠段当新情节。
para-3.listenEn: After a hit, check neighbors/scene cards; overlap is not a new plot.

pearl-tower-gift.genreZh: 弹词 / 戏曲交叉 · 珍珠塔 · 赠塔
pearl-tower-gift.genreEn: Tanci / theatre crossover · Pearl Tower · gift scene
pearl-tower-gift.registerZh: 赠塔嘱托：信物叙事，情义与功名并提。
pearl-tower-gift.registerEn: Gift counsel: token narrative; devotion beside career ambitions.
pearl-tower-gift.listenZh: 听「珍珠塔」信物与嘱咐套语；有说话人标注可对角色。
pearl-tower-gift.listenEn: Listen for pearl-tower token and counsel formulas; use speaker labels when present.

wunv-baishou-1.registerEn: Family ethics and birthday scenes; social exchange; song and speech.
wunv-baishou-1.listenZh: 跟「拜寿 / 冷暖」线索；分段档案便于跳读。
wunv-baishou-1.listenEn: Follow birthday / warmth–chill threads; segmented archive helps jump reading.

wunv-baishou-huashu.registerZh: 家庭伦理：拜寿、人情冷暖，唱念并重。
wunv-baishou-huashu.registerEn: Family ethics: birthday tribute, warmth and chill; song and speech.
wunv-baishou-huashu.listenZh: 先定「拜寿/人情」场景，再对档案句。
wunv-baishou-huashu.listenEn: Fix birthday/social scene first, then archive lines.

xianglin-sao-xinsuanhua.genreZh: 越剧 · 叙事唱段（祥林嫂）
xianglin-sao-xinsuanhua.registerZh: 诉苦叙事：口语化强，重复、叹息与控诉交织。
xianglin-sao-xinsuanhua.registerEn: Suffering narrative: more speech-like, with repetition, sighs, and accusation.
xianglin-sao-xinsuanhua.rolesZh: 祥林嫂（青衣 / 悲旦一路）
xianglin-sao-xinsuanhua.listenZh: 抓「丧子—冷遇—不公」关键词与哭腔起伏，比盯单字更稳。
xianglin-sao-xinsuanhua.listenEn: Track loss → cold treatment → injustice, plus sob-like contour, more than single characters.

xixiangji-kaohong.genreZh: 越剧 · 西厢记 · 拷红
xixiangji-kaohong.registerZh: 公堂式盘问：念白机智，花旦应对为主。
xixiangji-kaohong.registerEn: Interrogation tone: witty speech; huadan replies dominate.
xixiangji-kaohong.listenZh: 听盘问—辩解回合；称呼与语气比单字更稳。
xixiangji-kaohong.listenEn: Track question–defense turns; address and tone beat single characters.

zanghua-yin.registerZh: 抒情长段：花与人同命，文辞偏雅。
zanghua-yin.registerEn: Lyrical lament: flower and self share one fate; more literary diction.
zanghua-yin.listenZh: 抓落花、葬花、伤春意象链；雅词听不清时用档案句回填。
zanghua-yin.listenEn: Follow fallen blossoms → burial → spring grief; use archive line when literary diction fails ASR.

zhuiyu-guandeng.genreZh: 越剧 · 追鱼 · 观灯
zhuiyu-guandeng.genreEn: Yueju · Chase the Fish · lantern viewing
zhuiyu-guandeng.registerZh: 观灯抒情：景物与人情并写，唱段偏美。
zhuiyu-guandeng.registerEn: Lantern viewing lyric: scenery and feeling together; more melodic.
zhuiyu-guandeng.listenZh: 跟灯景意象与对唱呼应；不必句句听清。
zhuiyu-guandeng.listenEn: Follow lantern imagery and duet call–response; not every syllable.
